decisions.reason: The ticket-issuance rule does not change the existing requirements to display accurate prize-pool value and next-draw sales progress.

The current mission-page copy says only successful referrals generate tickets, but the source decision establishes one ticket for every primary mint, including no-referral mints, while excluding secondary-market sales.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: There should be as many commissions and tickets as mints (excluding secondary market sales), but it seems those sent out at random aren't registering

value_updates.prize_pools_copy: One affiliate from each 100-sales block wins $500 through a fair Chainlink VRF draw; every primary mint generates one ticket, including no-referral mints whose tickets are allocated at random, while secondary-market sales generate no tickets.
